Method of Attack: Crawls Facebook and LinkedIn accounts to steal personal information including name, email address, gender, mobile number, and address
Uploads stolen information to a remote backend server
Redirects search queries through a tracking URL to monitor user searches and IP addresses
Promoted via misleading advertisements claiming to secure searches and browser safety
Attack Vector: Installation via Chrome Web Store prompted by misleading advertisements
Extension permissions to access Facebook and LinkedIn user data
Indicators of Compromise: Network connections to www.browse-secure.com and backend.chupashop.com
